recipeRequirements.sourceText: 1. Locate the current dimension-schema revision and shared scoped-identity contracts. If hard prerequisites are not complete, document their exact missing acceptance and keep context activation blocked; independent existing workflows continue under their current guards.
recipeRequirements.finding: Existing exact-scope and immutable producer contracts are real. T007/T013 cards still lack completed reviewed handoffs; their status explicitly does not assert absence of code. ADR-0015 therefore does not authorize claiming new context activation.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: Task-wide T007 current-actor/shared-contract acceptance and T013 reviewed dimension producer-to-import handoff are not established by these selected source anchors or unrun fixtures. T006/T012 predecessor completion is not supplied by the cards.

recipeRequirements.sourceText: 2. Resolve profile, period, book decision, chart, mapping, dimensions, basis, currencies and policy versions from authorized server records. Do not pin a display name, arbitrary client-supplied revision or 'latest' at replay time.
recipeRequirements.finding: Reuse exact profile revision and published schema resolvers, canonical period/book records, approved chart/mapping and existing capability records. Mapping creation already requires an explicit approved chart when any approved client chart exists; do not claim implicit chart selection is still universally present. The scope resolver explicitly says a null book is not an approved no-book decision.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: No complete authorized all-consumed-pin activation owner was established in this bounded trace. Qualified framework/edition/effective-period, FX and consolidation policy revisions cannot be inferred from capability string fields or acceptance-stage APIs. Omit only genuinely unconsumed pins.

recipeRequirements.sourceText: 3. Define a canonical bounded manifest and hash. Scope it to firm/client and engagement when consumed; persist only the minimum identity/revision facts needed. Add scoped uniqueness/FKs and append-only/current-successor constraints using an additive migration.
recipeRequirements.finding: Canonical hashing, scoped lineage constraints and immutable producer snapshots already exist for narrower records. Package v1/v2 hash compatibility is explicit. These are reuse evidence, not proof of a complete persisted context manifest with all required keys/current-successor constraints.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: Whole-context manifest format, authoritative consumed-pin set, exact persistence owner and additive migration acceptance are unresolved until reviewed T007/T013 contracts and applicable policy references are available. No new migration or copied aggregate is proposed here.

recipeRequirements.sourceText: 4. Publish activation under the established context lock order with current approval checks and idempotent original intent. A changed consumed input creates a successor and invalidates currentness, while historical imports, workpapers and packages retain their original pin.
recipeRequirements.finding: Actual analogous publication paths were traced, not inferred from filenames: independent exact schema publication; firm/client/mapping-lock reviewed mapping approval; exact reviewed TB file/period publication and scoped retry recovery. Profile/schema successors retain history and packages retain original source pins. None substitutes for the requested complete context activation transaction.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: Context-specific lock owner, idempotent original-intent receipt, all-required-input successor/currentness invalidation and dependent historical pin preservation remain unverified as one end-to-end contract. Existing analog tests must not be relabeled context acceptance.

recipeRequirements.sourceText: 5. Expose exact basis and stale blockers in the existing UI with an authorized activation preview/review flow. A context is not professional approval; never make absent policy implicitly approved.
recipeRequirements.finding: Use the current accounting workspace/API and existing reviewed source/mapping flows. The UI already carries explicit period/basis/currency and missing-setup states. These anchors do not establish a unified context activation preview/review surface.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: Exact full context selector, consumed-policy basis display, context-specific stale blockers and authorized activation review are unresolved; professional acceptance is a separate evidence leaf. No new route, identity subsystem or optimistic approval is justified by this review.

recipeRequirements.sourceText: 6. Integrate one actual consumer at a time and preserve compatibility for historical records explicitly marked legacy/unbound. Do not backfill a fictional framework or revision.
recipeRequirements.finding: Integrate one actual consumer only after its authoritative prerequisites. Existing TB import binds period/book/basis and package construction preserves those source IDs; package hashing explicitly preserves legacy v1 and bound v2. The profile resolver explicitly refuses to invent unavailable historical snapshots.
recipeRequirements.unresolvedAcceptance: A whole-context consumer handoff and explicitly classified legacy/unbound context identity remain unverified. Legacy hash compatibility is not itself a new legacy reporting-context classification. Do not backfill a fictional framework, policy approval or revision.
